description: This file defines the 'Localizable' interface used for representing strings that can be localized within the Apache Commons Math3 project. It specifies methods for retrieving source and localized strings.

classes.name: Localizable
classes.description: An interface for localizable strings, allowing retrieval of source and localized strings based on locale.

methods.name: getSourceString
methods.description: Returns the original, non-localized source string.

methods.name: getLocalizedString
methods.description: Retrieves the localized string for a specified locale, or the source string if localization is unavailable.
